			var consentRequestId = 'consent_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
			var consentViewTracked = false;
			var storageKey = (settings.cookieName || 'plot_cookie_consent') + '_state';

			var getStoredState = function () {
				try {
					if (!window.localStorage) {
						return null;
					}

					var raw = window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
					if (!raw) {
						return null;
					}

					var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
					return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
				} catch (error) {
					return null;
				}
			};

			var storeState = function (state) {
				try {
					if (!window.localStorage) {
						return;
					}

					window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({
						has_choice: true,
						analytics: !!state.analytics,
						marketing: !!state.marketing
					}));
				} catch (error) {
				}
			};

			var trackConsentSignal = function (eventType, state) {
				if (!signalsSettings.ajaxUrl || !signalsSettings.nonce) {
					return;
				}

				var payload = new URLSearchParams();
				payload.append('action', 'plot_signals_track');
				payload.append('nonce', signalsSettings.nonce);
				payload.append('event_type', eventType);
				payload.append('visitor_id', consentRequestId);
				payload.append('session_id', consentRequestId);
				payload.append('page_path', window.location.pathname || '/');

				if (state) {
					payload.append('meta_json', JSON.stringify({
						analytics: !!state.analytics,
						marketing: !!state.marketing
					}));
				}

				if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
					var blob = new Blob([payload.toString()], {type: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8'});
					navigator.sendBeacon(signalsSettings.ajaxUrl, blob);
					return;
				}

				if (window.fetch) {
					fetch(signalsSettings.ajaxUrl, {
						method: 'POST',
						body: payload,
						credentials: 'same-origin',
						keepalive: true,
						headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8'}
					});
				}
			};

			var persistConsent = function (state) {
				var cookieName = settings.cookieName || 'plot_cookie_consent';
				var ttlDays = parseInt(settings.cookieTtlDays || '180', 10) || 180;
				var expires = new Date(Date.now() + ttlDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
				var secure = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '';
				var payload = {
					analytics: !!state.analytics,
					marketing: !!state.marketing
				};

				trackConsentSignal(state.analytics ? 'consent_accept' : 'consent_decline', state);
				storeState(payload);
				document.cookie = cookieName + '=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(payload)) + '; expires=' + expires.toUTCString() + '; max-age=' + (ttlDays * 24 * 60 * 60) + '; path=/; SameSite=Lax' + secure;
				banner.hidden = true;
				window.setTimeout(function () {
					window.location.reload();
				}, 50);
			};

			if (getStoredState()) {
				banner.hidden = true;
				return;
			}

			window.__plotConsentBannerInitialized = true;

			if (!consentViewTracked) {
				trackConsentSignal('consent_banner_view');
				consentViewTracked = true;
			}

			if (acceptAll) {
				acceptAll.addEventListener('click', function () {
					persistConsent({
						analytics: true,
						marketing: true
					});
				});
			}

			if (essentialOnly) {
				essentialOnly.addEventListener('click', function () {
					persistConsent({
						analytics: false,
						marketing: false
					});
				});
			}

			if (manage && preferences) {
				manage.addEventListener('click', function () {
					window.setTimeout(function () {
						preferences.hidden = false;
						preferences.removeAttribute('hidden');
						manage.hidden = true;
						manage.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden');
					}, 0);
				});
			}

			if (save) {
				save.addEventListener('click', function () {
					persistConsent({
						analytics: !!(analytics && analytics.checked),
						marketing: !!(marketing && marketing.checked)
					});
				});
			}
		})();
	</script>
